# Reading · 阅读

The articles, books, courses and guidelines whose ideas shape this suite. Prefer primary, durable sources; name the principle when justifying a decision.

70 resources, plus 6 cross-listed from other domains. Columns are explained in README.md; `scripts/catalog.py find` searches every domain at once. Rows are sorted by tier, then by reach, so what an agent can fetch comes first.

## Interface craft and design engineering · 界面工艺与设计工程

The details that make interfaces feel right, and robust CSS thinking.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Vercel Web Interface Guidelines (home: ai)](https://vercel.com/design/guidelines) | Concise, opinionated rules for interactions, animation, layout, content, forms, performance and design, shipped with an agent-readable file | Give the agent the raw AGENTS.md (MUST, SHOULD and NEVER rules for keyboard, focus, forms, animation, layout, content and performance) as a review checklist for web UI. | S | guideline | static | free · MIT (github.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines) | [AGENTS.md (raw)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines/main/AGENTS.md) |

| [Sara Soueidan and Practical Accessibility (home: a11y)](https://www.sarasoueidan.com) | Deep articles on accessible front-end (accessible names, custom controls, SVG, CSS-generated content) and the Practical Accessibility video course for designers and developers | Read the matching article before building a custom control or an SVG icon system; the course is the structured route for a team that designs and builds its own components. | A | article | static | freemium | [Practical Accessibility (course, paid)](https://practical-accessibility.today) |

| [How we redesigned the Linear UI](https://linear.app/now/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui) | A disciplined product redesign: reduce, align, rebuild the theme system in LCH | Model for a redesign that keeps equity | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Atomic Design](https://atomicdesign.bradfrost.com) | Brad Frost's free web book on building interface systems | Read chapter 2 for the mental model | A | book | static | free · archived |  |

| [Ahmad Shadeed](https://ishadeed.com) | Deep, visual CSS articles on layout, defensive CSS and RTL | Look up the component you are about to build | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Defensive CSS](https://defensivecss.dev) | Patterns that keep layouts from breaking with real content | Checklist for long text, missing images, overflow | A | guideline | static | free |  |
| [Maggie Appleton](https://maggieappleton.com) | Illustrated essays on language-model interfaces and tools for thought | Perspective for AI product concepts | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Jhey Tompkins](https://www.jhey.dev) | Inventive CSS and interaction demos with explanations, often the first to use new platform features | Search his demos before building a scroll, hover or anchor-positioning effect | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Adam Argyle (nerdy.dev)](https://nerdy.dev) | CSS and UI craft from the author of Open Props and the GUI Challenges series | Use the GUI Challenges posts for accessible, modern implementations of common components | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Smashing Magazine](https://www.smashingmagazine.com) | Long-running practitioner magazine on UX, CSS, accessibility and design systems | Browse /category/<ux-design\|css\|accessibility> or search a pattern name; articles are long, practical and dated | A | article | static | free | [UX design category](https://www.smashingmagazine.com/category/ux-design/); [RSS feed](https://www.smashingmagazine.com/feed/) |

## Designing with and for AI · 与 AI 一起做设计

Why models produce generic design and what changes that; design in AI-era products.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Maggie Appleton (home: interface-craft)](https://maggieappleton.com) | Illustrated essays on language-model interfaces and tools for thought | Perspective for AI product concepts | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Improving frontend design through Skills](https://claude.com/blog/improving-frontend-design-through-skills) | Anthropic on why models converge on generic design (distributional convergence), which prompt axes move output (typography, themes, motion, backgrounds) and a ~400-token aesthetics prompt; published 2025-11-12 | Read with the current skill: several remedies it recommended in 2025 are flagged as tells by 2026 detectors | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Prompting for frontend aesthetics](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-cookbooks/blob/main/coding/prompting_for_frontend_aesthetics.ipynb) | Cookbook showing which prompt levers change front-end aesthetics (typography, themes, motion, backgrounds) | Evidence for which instructions actually move output | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Design for the AI age](https://linear.app/now/design-for-the-ai-age) | Linear's view on designing software where AI agents are users and collaborators | Framing for AI-product briefs | A | article | static | free |  |
| [AI and design systems](https://bradfrost.com/blog/post/ai-and-design-systems/) | How design systems become the constraint layer for AI-generated UI | Argument for investing in tokens before generation | A | article | static | free |  |
| [Why Chatbots Are Not the Future of Interfaces](https://wattenberger.com/thoughts/boo-chatbots) | Amelia Wattenberger's illustrated essay on why a text box is a poor default interface for language models, and what to design instead | Read before defaulting an AI feature to a chat panel; use it to argue for inline, contextual controls | A | article | static | free · archived |  |
| [Malleable software (Ink & Switch)](https://www.inkandswitch.com/essay/malleable-software/) | Ink & Switch's essay on restoring user agency in locked-down apps, and how AI changes who can reshape software | Read when a brief proposes generated or user-customisable UI; use it to decide what users should be able to reshape | A | article | static | free · archived |  |

## Visual design fundamentals · 视觉基础

Hierarchy, spacing, perception. Start with the first three.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Visual design rules you can safely follow every time](https://anthonyhobday.com/sideprojects/saferules/) | A plain list of visual design rules with brief explanations | Use as a lint list for a finished screen | S | article | static | free |  |
| [Laws of UX](https://lawsofux.com) | The perception and cognition principles designers cite (Fitts, Hick, Jakob, Miller, proximity, peak-end...) with sources | Match the scenario to a law, then cite its takeaways and origin; each law page lists sources | S | guideline | static | free | [llms.txt (every law, one line each)](https://lawsofux.com/llms.txt) |
| [Refactoring UI](https://www.refactoringui.com) | Tactical UI design book for developers by the Tailwind authors | Start with the free Medium article (entry point), then the chapters on hierarchy, spacing and colour; the single best purchase for an engineer who designs | A | book | static | paid | [Free article: 7 practical tips for cheating at design (Medium)](https://medium.com/refactoring-ui/7-practical-tips-for-cheating-at-design-40c736799886) |
| [7 Rules for Creating Gorgeous UI](https://www.learnui.design/blog/7-rules-for-creating-gorgeous-ui-part-1.html) | Erik Kennedy's rules: light comes from the sky, black and white first, double your whitespace | Run the seven rules (light from the sky, black and white first, double the whitespace, text over images…) as a quick pass on a finished screen | A | article | static | free · archived |  |
| [Dieter Rams: ten principles for good design](https://www.vitsoe.com/us/about/good-design) | The ten principles, from the source | A yardstick for restraint | A | article | static | free · archived |  |
| [The Web's Grain](https://frankchimero.com/blog/2015/the-webs-grain/) | Frank Chimero on designing with the nature of the web instead of against it | Read when a layout fights the medium | A | article | static | free · archived |  |
| [Magic Ink](https://worrydream.com/MagicInk/) | Bret Victor's argument that most software is information design, not interaction design | Reframe dashboards and tools as graphics to be read | A | article | static | free · archived |  |
| [Practical UI](https://www.practical-ui.com) | Adham Dannaway's rule-based book and Figma kit for logical, accessible interface design | Adopt its explicit rules (spacing, hierarchy, contrast) as a critique checklist | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Gestalt principles](https://ixdf.org/literature/topics/gestalt-principles) | Overview of the grouping principles behind layout decisions | Reference when explaining grouping choices | A | article | blocked | free |  |

## Research-backed UX guidance · 有研究背书的 UX 指引

Evidence to cite instead of opinion.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [NN/g: 10 usability heuristics](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/ten-usability-heuristics/) | The standard heuristic-evaluation framework | Tag critique findings with the heuristic violated | S | article | static | free |  |
| [Nielsen Norman Group articles](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/) | Decades of research-based UX guidance | Search before asserting a usability claim | S | article | static | free |  |
| [Baymard Institute](https://baymard.com/blog) | Large-scale e-commerce and form usability research; articles free, full database paid | Check before designing checkout, search, filters or forms | S | article | static | freemium | [llms.txt (article index)](https://baymard.com/llms.txt) |
| [NN/g: response time limits](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/response-times-3-important-limits/) | The 0.1 s, 1 s and 10 s limits that govern feedback design | Cite for loading-state decisions | A | article | static | free · archived |  |
| [Growth.Design case studies](https://growth.design/case-studies) | Product UX teardowns told as comics, tied to psychology principles | Read the teardown of a comparable flow; agents append /markdown to any case-study URL for clean text | A | article | static | free | [Case study as Markdown (append /markdown)](https://growth.design/case-studies/duolingo-user-retention/markdown) |
| [LukeW](https://www.lukew.com/ff/) | Luke Wroblewski's notes on forms, mobile and input design with data | Search for form-design evidence | A | article | static | free |  |
| [GOV.UK design principles](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/government-design-principles) | Ten principles for user-centred services | Start with user needs; do the hard work to make it simple | A | guideline | static | free |  |
| [Built for Mars](https://builtformars.com) | Peter Ramsey's step-by-step UX case studies of real products (onboarding, banking, checkout) plus 1,400+ UX examples | Read the case study for the flow you are designing; feeds exist for case studies and UX Bites | A | article | static | freemium | [Case studies](https://builtformars.com/case-studies); [llms.txt](https://builtformars.com/llms.txt) |
| [MeasuringU](https://measuringu.com) | Quantitative UX research: benchmarks, SUS and sample sizes explained with data | Use when a claim needs numbers rather than opinion (task time, SUS norms, how many users to test) | A | article | static | free |  |
| [UX Myths](https://uxmyths.com) | Common UX misconceptions with research that refutes them | Settle arguments such as the three-click rule | B | archive | static | free · archived |  |

## Books · 书

The canon. Paid unless noted.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Tier | Kind | Reach | Access · licence | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [The Visual Display of Quantitative Information (home: dataviz)](https://www.edwardtufte.com/book/the-visual-display-of-quantitative-information/) | Tufte on data-ink, chartjunk and graphical integrity | Read the chapters on graphical integrity and data-ink before a dashboard critique; cite the lie factor and chartjunk by name. | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Storytelling with Data (home: dataviz)](https://www.storytellingwithdata.com/books) | Practical business chart design and narrative | For decks and dashboards aimed at managers: remove clutter first, then focus attention with one accent colour and an action title that states the takeaway. | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Fundamentals of Data Visualization (home: dataviz)](https://clauswilke.com/dataviz/) | Claus Wilke's complete book, free online: choosing visualisations, colour use and pitfalls, proportional ink, overlapping points, and figure design | Read the colour chapters (colour scales, common pitfalls of colour use) and 'The principle of proportional ink' before designing charts; the whole text is static HTML an agent can read. | A | book | static | free |  |
| [The Big Book of Dashboards (home: dataviz)](https://www.bigbookofdashboards.com) | Real business dashboards grouped by scenario, each with expert critique of what works and why | Find the scenario closest to the brief (executive summary, operations, sales, health care) and borrow its layout logic; the site hosts the dashboards shown in the book. | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Don't Make Me Think](https://sensible.com/dont-make-me-think/) | Steve Krug's short classic on web usability | First usability book to read | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [The Design of Everyday Things](https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/don-norman/the-design-of-everyday-things/9780465050659/) | Don Norman on affordances, signifiers, mapping and feedback | The vocabulary of interaction design | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Grid Systems in Graphic Design](https://niggli.ch/en/products/rastersysteme-fur-die-visuelle-gestaltung) | Mueller-Brockmann's definitive manual on grids | Reference for poster, editorial and deck layout | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [The Elements of Typographic Style](https://typographica.org/typography-books/the-elements-of-typographic-style-4th-edition/) | Robert Bringhurst's reference on proportion, rhythm, spacing and the details of Latin typesetting (v4.0) | Consult the chapters on rhythm and proportion (measure, leading) and on the page before inventing a rule; the link is Typographica's review, the book is in print from Hartley & Marks | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Interaction of Color](https://yalebooks.yale.edu/book/9780300179354/interaction-of-color/) | Albers on how colours change each other | Why a colour looks wrong in context | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Microcopy: The Complete Guide](https://www.microcopybook.com) | Kinneret Yifrah's guide to interface words | Reference for error, empty-state and button copy | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Form Design Patterns](https://www.smashingmagazine.com/printed-books/form-design-patterns/) | Adam Silver's inclusive form patterns | Before designing any complex form | A | book | static | paid |  |
| [Designing Interface Animation](https://rosenfeldmedia.com/books/designing-interface-animation/) | Val Head's book on purposeful UI animation | Depth on motion in design systems | A | book | blocked | paid |  |
